explication: This repository is a teaching guide, not an automation tool: an administrator consults its recommendations to learn about and apply Linux server hardening. The README documents setup, SSH, host basics, network defenses, auditing, and miscellaneous topics; the tree also includes standalone sysctl-hardening and Nginx guides. No source excerpts were available, so links between those standalone guides and README topics are not inferred.
